raw_label: Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology

Official university page uses BRAC University. Source: https://www.bracu.ac.bd/ (checked 2026-09-26).
Official university page identifies Bangladesh Agricultural University and BAU. Source: https://bau.edu.bd/ (checked 2026-09-26).

raw_label: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology
proposed_canonical_institution: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology
evidence: Official BUET department identifies its parent university by this full name. The BUET institutional history distinguishes its earlier engineering-college name from the separately founded AUST. Source: https://cse.buet.ac.bd/ (checked 2026-09-26).

Official vision and mission page identifies East West University as the institution. Source: https://ewubd.edu/vision-mission-ewu (checked 2026-09-26).

Official university page identifies Islamic University in Kushtia, Bangladesh. It is distinct from Independent University, Bangladesh. Source: https://iu.ac.bd/ (checked 2026-09-26).
